title: FLF -06 AN PTFE Swivel Hose End
description: Designed specifically for use with PTFE-lined braided hose. CNC-machined from 6061-T6 billet aluminum with a durable anodized finish. Features a 360-degree swivel head for easy alignment during installation and includes brass olives (ferrules) for a leak-free, high-pressure seal compatible with E85, race gas, and oil.
